purpose: Close the characteristic-two loophole left by the edge-dependent matchgate gauge barrier. The v2.7 proof used 2!=0. In characteristic two, use Cayley's 2x2x2 hyperdeterminant to prove that EQ3 itself cannot be mapped by any invertible local edge gauges to a pure-parity tensor, so the clause tensor need not even be considered.

tensor.local_gauge: T'=(S1 tensor S2 tensor S3)T with arbitrary invertible 2x2 matrices S1,S2,S3 over a field of characteristic two.
tensor.matchgate_necessary_condition: Every matchgate signature has support entirely on one Hamming parity. Thus local matchgate conversion requires T' to be pure even or pure odd.

hyperdeterminant_facts.relative_invariance: Delta((S1 tensor S2 tensor S3)T)=Delta(T) det(S1)^2 det(S2)^2 det(S3)^2. This is a polynomial identity over the integers and therefore remains valid after reduction to characteristic two.

theorem.name: CHAR2_EQ3_CANNOT_BE_LOCALLY_GAUGED_TO_PURE_PARITY
proof: In characteristic two the coefficients 2 and 4 vanish. Hence Delta(A)=a000^2 a111^2+a001^2 a110^2+a010^2 a101^2+a100^2 a011^2.
Each displayed product pairs a bit string with its bitwise complement. For arity three, complements have opposite Hamming parity.
If A has support only on even strings, or only on odd strings, every complementary product contains one zero factor. Therefore Delta(A)=0 for every pure-parity 2x2x2 tensor in characteristic two.
EQ3 has Delta=1. Under invertible local gauges the relative-invariance factor det(S1)^2 det(S2)^2 det(S3)^2 is nonzero, so Delta(T') is nonzero.
Thus T' cannot have pure parity. Since pure parity is necessary for a matchgate signature, no invertible edge-dependent local gauge can turn EQ3 into a matchgate in characteristic two.

scope.strengthening: Together with v2.7, the original-network local holographic/matchgate conversion is blocked in every characteristic: v2.7 handles characteristic not equal to two; this artifact handles characteristic two already on the variable side.
not_killed: A genuinely nonlocal topology-changing Pfaffian construction coupling several EQ3/rank-3 switches before contraction.
Decision algorithms outside local matchgate/holographic conversion.
